name: Comment prompt
summary: Speech-bubble icon with typing dots, then a short comment bubble pops out; for comment calls to action.

params.name: text
params.note: the comment shown in the bubble; keep it short

params.name: popAt
params.note: frames after at when the comment pops out

params.name: color
params.note: icon colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

author: krakujs
